title.narrative: Localization: Strengthening Networks and Advancing Shared Goals on Resilience

description.narrative:
Overall Objective:To refine and enhance Christian Aid’s country strategy by incorporating lessons from 2025, engaging key stakeholders, and ensuring alignment with evolving local and global priorities particularly on resilience building at the community level for climate change and post conflict preparedness. Specific Objectives:
To assess the implementation progress of the 2025 strategy and identify gaps and areas for improvement. To update the country strategy based on new evidence, stakeholder feedback, and emerging priorities. To enhance collaboration between Christian Aid and its partners, strengthening joint programming approaches. To document best practices and lessons learned to inform future strategy development efforts.
